description: "Wallenstein's Camp: A Play" by Friedrich Schiller is a dramatic prologue written in 1799. Set during the Thirty Years' War in 1633, this work introduces the legendary general Albrecht von Wallenstein through the eyes of his diverse mercenary soldiers.
